title: Alter Table [add column, rename to]
description:
The `ALTER TABLE` statment has 4 operations. In this lesson, i will be teaching the first 2: add column and rename to. Alter table syntax is as such:
```sql
ALTER TABLE table_name OPERATION values;
```
What `RENAME TO` does is it renames a table, so 
```sql
ALTER TABLE table_name RENAME TO new_name;
```
And `ADD COLUMN` adds a column. With syntax
```sql
ALTER TABLE table_name
    ADD COLUMN column_definition;
-- E.G.
ALTER TABLE users
    ADD COULMN name TEXT UNIQUE;
```

# Assignment:
Somebody at the BWS team did a bit of a oops. He named our deployments table departments, and forgot the version TEXT column. Fix it using `ALTER TABLE`.
setupCode: CREATE TABLE departments (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, app_name TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT DEFAULT 'pending', region TEXT);
runHarness:
INSERT INTO deployments (app_name, status, region, version) VALUES ('BWS-API', 'running', 'us-east', '1.0.0');
SELECT * FROM deployments;
expectedOutput:
id | app_name | status | region | version
1 | BWS-API | running | us-east | 1.0.0
